qd-hil-224.fact: Leaves pass extremely slowly through its multi-chambered stomach, and the contents of its gut make up a large part of the animal's weight.
qd-hil-224.prompt: Digesting a single leaf can take a sloth up to 50 days.

qd-hil-225.fact: A single fertilized egg splits into four embryos, so every litter is naturally a set of identical quadruplets.
qd-hil-225.prompt: The nine-banded armadillo always gives birth to 2 genetically identical pups.

qd-hil-226.fact: About two thirds of its neurons lie outside the central brain, so the arms process a lot of stimuli very independently.
qd-hil-226.prompt: An octopus has about 85% of its neurons in its arms.

qd-hil-227.fact: The beetle only mixes the chemicals in a reaction chamber and fires the boiling, irritating spray in rapid pulses.
qd-hil-227.prompt: The bombardier beetle sprays a defensive mix at about 70 °C.

qd-hil-228.fact: Its temperature is unusually low for a mammal and stays stable even during long hunts for food in cold water.
qd-hil-228.prompt: The platypus has a body temperature of about 40 °C.

qd-hil-229.fact: A4 measures 210 by 297 millimeters, and its sides are in a ratio of one to the square root of two.
qd-hil-229.prompt: The long side of an A4 sheet is 240 millimeters.

qd-hil-230.fact: Most of Europe uses fifty hertz, while sixty hertz is the standard in North America.
qd-hil-230.prompt: The power grid in Slovakia runs at 60 Hz.

qd-hil-231.fact: Four hundred years contain 303 common years and 97 leap years; together that's 146,097 days, or exactly 20,871 weeks.
qd-hil-231.prompt: A full 400-year cycle of the Gregorian calendar has 120,000 days.

qd-hil-232.fact: Each of the six dots can be raised or not, so a cell gives two to the sixth power, or 64, combinations.
qd-hil-232.prompt: A classic six-dot Braille cell allows 80 patterns, including the blank one.

qd-hil-233.fact: The first twelve digits are multiplied alternately by weights of one and three; the check digit brings the sum up to a multiple of ten.
qd-hil-233.prompt: The ISBN-13 check digit is calculated modulo 8.

qd-hil-234.fact: The ISO 2533 reference model sets the temperature at mean sea level at 15 °C, or 288.15 K; it isn't the actual air temperature.
qd-hil-234.prompt: The ISO 2533 standard atmosphere has a sea-level temperature of 20 °C.
